name: smwpatches-move-left-at-goal-flag
title: Move Left at Goal Flag
description:
Adds a flag (with customizable freeram) that can be set to:
1) Make Mario walk left instead of right when ending a level
2) Flip the goal tape GFX accordingly
It should work with any means to end a level, as it hijacks directly into that routine.
Set the flag with uberasm or similar.
